title: Clinically Relevant Asymmetry of Bispectral Index
brief_summary: BIS for monitoring depth of anesthesia is usually obtained unilaterally. Obtaining BIS bilaterally revealed side differences in previous studies. This study investigates the incidence of clinically relevant side differences of BIS during maintenance and emergence from anesthesia for ENT surgery in both adults and children.
